Under “Predator Fishes” there are connecting lines leading to lower-level boxes such as “Herbivore Fishes”, “Herbivore Inverts”, and “Planktivore Fishes”. Reasoning: The question asks what predator fishes consume. According to the rule in a food web that upper-level predators eat the lower-level connected organisms, Predator Fishes will eat the fish prey connected to them, such as Herbivore Fishes and Planktivore Fishes. Therefore, in summary, predator fishes consume other fish.
